(Next high-impact: ADP 08:15 ET Sep 30; GDP third estimate + PCE 08:30 ET Sep 30. Monthly equity OPEX Fri Oct 16. No FOMC or quad-witching in window.)

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**Window overlapping next 30d** — ASTS — BlueBird 14-16 production complete / preparing; possible later Falcon 9 slot — inferred / window; no company-confirmed NET date in 30d.
**~Oct 2026** — TMC — NOAA certification of USA-A application — estimated (mgmt guidance).
ASTS: no dated events found in 30d.
TMC: no additional firm ISA / vessel / offtake / Project Crucible dates in 30d.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)
ASTS:
- Huiwen Yao (CTO): planned 10b5-1 sale 40,000 shares @ weighted avg ~$58.93 (range $57.52–$60.31) on 16 Sep; remaining direct ~34,750. Filing ~17 Sep.
- Shanti B. Gupta (COO): open-market sale 12,000 @ weighted avg ~$58.89 on 16 Sep; remaining direct 462,980. Filing ~17 Sep.
No additional open-market Form 4/144 in last 14d.

TMC:
- Andrew Hall (Director): RSU grant 72,935 shares (price $0) on 11 Sep under 2021 Equity Incentive Plan. No open-market buys/sales in last 14d.

## Rates and bonds
10y ~4.98–4.99% (+1–2 bp overnight); 2y ~4.77–4.80% (+2–5 bp); 10y–2y spread ~+18–20 bp (not inverted). 5y nominal ~4.86%. TIPS/breakeven data sparse this print; real yields elevated vs recent months. One sentence: yields edging higher on growth resilience post-Sep FOMC hike, inflation expectations still anchored near 2% medium-term, Fed path now pricing fewer cuts.

## USD/JPY
Spot ~157.75–157.85 (+0.3–0.4 overnight). Short trend higher vs recent weeks (held 155–158 range). US yields support; no fresh BoJ intervention chatter this morning.

## Equities tape
SPX ~7,700s area (near recent highs, ~flat-to-soft overnight futures); QQQ/NDX mixed; IWM ~286. Breadth proxies constructive but data thin pre-open. VIX ~14.2 (low-vol regime, down from ~14.9).

## Names / themes only if material overnight
Nothing material overnight on ASTS, TMC/TMCR, critical minerals, or space/spectrum.

## What actually matters this morning
- S&P Global flash PMIs + Barr speech (activity + Fed tone)
- Claims + New Home Sales Thursday (labor/housing)
- TMC NOAA certification still the near-term estimated catalyst (~Oct)
- ASTS production cadence continues with no dated launch NET in 30d
- Low VIX / quiet calendar until later-week data
